title: dombeya boivinii

It is a flowering plant used in traditional medicine in Madagascar, and its leaves, roots, and stem are valued for their therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Dombeya boivinii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties.
